summary: The StudentExpenseHistory component is a user control in a web application that is responsible for displaying the expense history of a student. It interacts with the data layer to fetch and present data based on a given student's ID.
purpose: To provide a web-based interface for viewing the historical expense data associated with a student, leveraging the .NET Framework.

fields.name: updPnlMain
fields.description: Main update panel for the control.

fields.name: cmdPrint
fields.description: Button to trigger printing of the expense history.

fields.name: rprHistory
fields.description: Repeater control to display the list of expense history entries.

fields.name: dsHistory
fields.description: Data source control for fetching history data.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: Identifier for the student whose expense history is being displayed.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Represents the session of the user currently interacting with the application.

workflows.name: Displaying Expense History
steps: Page_Load: Initializes the control and prepares it for data binding if necessary.
dsHistory_Selecting: Sets parameters required for fetching data from the data source, cancelling if the UserSession is null.
RefreshData: Rebinds the data to the repeater control, ensuring the interface is updated with the latest data.
rprHistory_ItemDataBound: Customizes the display of each item in the repeater based on the type of list item (item or alternating item).

validations.action: Cancel the selection operation for dsHistory.

system_behavior: Cancels data retrieval operations if the user session is not available.
Binds and refreshes displayed data based on user and student context.
